713:t_163:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so, I will fight!」

713:t_163:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is the life I chose!!」

713:t_164:0.en:
$$レド$$
「You can't escape the bonds called your mission! You're just like I used to be!」

713:t_164:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Living should mean greater freedom! Understand that!」

713:t_164:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I abandoned everything to come this far. I cannot change how I live now!」

713:t_164:3.en:
$$レド$$
「Why can't you understand that you are making yourself and everyone around you miserable?!」

713:t_164:4.en:
$$レド$$
「If you can't stop yourself, I... we will stop you, just as others once did for me!!」

713:t_164:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then come! Show me what a man separated from his pack can do!!」

713:t_165:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Do not think a mere soldier can defeat me, a general!」

713:t_165:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Before I am a soldier, I am human. Before you are a general, you are a coward. I will not lose to the likes of you.」

713:t_165:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You call me a coward?」

713:t_165:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「Even that is too mild for a man without the courage to change himself!」

713:t_165:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Even a man like me could do it! I won't let you say you can't, you coward!」

713:t_165:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You mock my life, and the souls I took...」

713:t_165:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you have time for excuses, come! I, a common soldier, will reeducate you, a general!!」

713:t_166:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You have come this far regretting your life, yet unable to change it.」

713:t_166:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I have already overcome my doubts.」

713:t_166:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You're wrong! You've only put a lid on your doubting heart!」

713:t_166:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You've lost your words! Then I'll brand defeat into you and end your long journey of regret!」

713:t_166:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「When my battle ends... that will be the moment they perish!」

713:t_166:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Until that day, I will keep fighting! That is how I repay the fallen souls!」

713:t_166:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You pile up sins that way, just as I once did! That is why I will stop you!!」

713:t_167:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, $$異能生存体$$! If you surpass causality, I will surpass your existence!」

713:t_167:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Fighting a battle you don't even want to fight... You're no different from how I used to be.」

713:t_167:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「You seem to be another man who knows nothing but fighting.」

713:t_167:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is the meaning of my life.」

713:t_167:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「If that is what you believe, so be it.」

713:t_167:5.en:
$$キリコ$$
「But I have no intention of joining you.」

713:t_168:0.en:
$$桂$$
「If you wanted to defeat the $$御使い$$s, you should have just said so. I would have helped you.」

713:t_168:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It is not too late. Come under my command, $$特異点$$.」

713:t_168:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will need you too, as my final trump card.」

713:t_168:3.en:
$$桂$$
「If I say no, you'll just use force anyway, right?」

713:t_168:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is correct! I cannot afford to be choosy about my methods!」

713:t_168:5.en:
$$桂$$
「We're just as desperate! Don't think you're the only special one!」

713:t_168:6.en:
$$桂$$
「I hate bastards who force their way with power!」

713:t_168:7.en:
$$桂$$
「In the end, you've become just like the people you hate most!」

713:t_169:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$! Recognize your own mission!」

713:t_169:1.en:
$n
「I know it without you telling me.」

713:t_169:2.en:
$n
「But I don't think it's all right to sacrifice everything in the name of a mission, like you do!」

713:t_169:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Are you going to run away?!」

713:t_169:4.en:
$n
「You have no right to decide that!」

713:t_169:5.en:
$n
「I decide how to use my life! You've fought by taking other people's lives, and I won't let you have your way!」

713:t_169:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is my battle! I will take your $$スフィア$$!!」

713:t_170:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$悲しみの乙女$$. If you wish to end the fighting, offer that power to me.」

713:t_170:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア$$ lives within me, along with his hatred. You too...」

713:t_170:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「My life is mine! I will not hand myself or my $$スフィア$$ over to your selfish reasoning!」

713:t_170:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Though you seek to slay the $$御使い$$s, you chose the same methods as them! You are my enemy!」

713:t_170:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I expected that answer! As I thought, I must take the $$スフィア$$s by force!」

713:t_170:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Taking from others creates sorrow! I will stop that!!」

713:t_171:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You have come, $$傷だらけの獅子$$! Your power...」

713:t_171:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Spare me the words! You know neither of us is the kind of man who can be stopped by words!」

713:t_171:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't thank someone who's about to punch you! You're taking the wind out of my sails!」

713:t_171:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Here I come, $$ヴィルダーク$$! I'll punch you with all I've got and stop your ridiculous battle!」

713:t_171:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will not stop! I will take your $$スフィア$$ and challenge the $$御使い$$s!!」

713:t_172:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I heard from the woman. $$ヴァイシュラバ$$ apparently thought highly of you.」

713:t_172:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm honored. ...I'd like to say that, but praise from a villain won't earn me a single cent.」

713:t_172:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Not that I'm such a fine man that I can judge him or you.」

713:t_172:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so, you will face me, $$揺れる天秤$$?」

713:t_172:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It isn't a question of good or evil. I just don't like your methods.」

713:t_172:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Is that your unbreakable will?」

713:t_172:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I don't need a catchphrase like that. Come on, $$ヴィルダーク$$.」

713:t_172:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Go on ahead to the afterlife and have a reunion with $$ガイオウ$$!」

713:t_172:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I refuse! You will be my messenger, telling him how I lived!!」
